title: Endocrine system anatomy
description: The body's slow wiring: hormones released straight into blood to tune metabolism, growth, stress, salt, sugar and reproduction.

questions.question: What organs make up the endocrine system?
questions.answer: The endocrine system includes hormone-producing structures such as the pituitary, thyroid, parathyroids, adrenals and pancreatic islets, with other organs also contributing hormones.

questions.question: How do endocrine glands differ from exocrine glands?
questions.answer: Endocrine tissue releases hormones into the blood. Exocrine glands deliver products through ducts to a surface or lumen, as pancreatic acini do for digestion.

questions.question: What is the pituitary gland?
questions.answer: Pea-sized master gland in the sella turcica. Function: Releases ACTH, TSH, GH, LH/FSH, prolactin, ADH/oxytocin store.

questions.question: Where in the neck is the thyroid gland located?
questions.answer: Butterfly gland on the trachea. Function: T3/T4 metabolic rate; calcitonin.

questions.question: What is the function of the adrenal glands?
questions.answer: Function: Cortisol, aldosterone, adrenaline. Caps on each kidney: cortex + medulla.
